# Material usage API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

One material used in a procedure, such as a drug, a virus or a probe, with its amount and its source.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusage/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/materialusage/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `materialusage` (detail, create, update), `materialusages` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `procedure.subject.projects` or `specimen_procedure.specimen_set.projects` or `experimental_interface.subject.projects` or `experimental_interface.specimen_set.projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [MaterialUsage type](/api/schemas/materialusage/); send its fields in `details_json` (responses return them as `details`). `details_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** clears the link on [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/) records

Form-only inputs (sent on create or update, not returned in responses):

- `source` **[required]**. Choices: `inventory`, `catalog`, `manual`. Choose a consumable stock, a consumable, or enter the identity manually.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `procedure` | [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/) id; nullable |
| `specimen_procedure` | [`specimenprocedure`](/api/modules/specimenprocedure/) id; nullable |
| `experimental_interface` | [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/) id; nullable. The interface this material is part of. An interface records what it is made of the same way a procedure records what it used. |
| `consumable_stock` | [`consumablestock`](/api/modules/consumablestock/) id; nullable |
| `consumable` | [`consumable`](/api/resources/consumable/) id; nullable |
| `manual_source` | JSON object **[write-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [MaterialUsage types](/api/schemas/materialusage/) **[required]** |
| `stage` | `modules.procedurestage` id; nullable. The ordered stage of the parent procedure this material took part in, when the parent type declares stages. |
| `order` | number **[required]** |
| `details` | JSON object **[read-only]** |
| `target_specimens` | list of strings **[write-only]** |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters |
| `details_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `source_provenance` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `source_tier` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `source_tier_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `source_identity` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `summary` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `copied_from_procedure` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusage/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('materialusage', load_all=True)
records = resp['materialusages']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('materialusage', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.materialusages;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusage/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('materialusage', data={"type": "ActiveAgent", "order": 1, "details_json": {"...": "the fields of the selected MaterialUsage type"}, "source": "inventory", "procedure": "<procedure-id>", "consumable_stock": "<consumablestock-id>"})
record = resp.json()['materialusage']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'ActiveAgent', 'order', 1, 'details_json', struct(), 'source', 'inventory', 'procedure', '<procedure-id>', 'consumable_stock', '<consumablestock-id>'), 'materialusage');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.materialusage;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusage/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('materialusage', id='<id>', data={"order": 1})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'order', 1), 'materialusage', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusage/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('materialusage', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'materialusage');
```
